<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical‑shift ranges with retrieve_carbon_shifts to identify the aromatic region (generally ~120–150 ppm). By counting how many peaks in the spectrum fall within that aromatic range, I can report the integer number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
